remarks: Sellers will consider offers starting at $499,900. Welcome to 598 Baseline Road, situated on approximately 2 acres on Grand Island & conveniently located near parks, trails, waterfront recreation, & more. This spacious 3/4 bedroom, 1.5-bath home offers plenty of living space inside & an incredible backyard built for entertaining. The first floor features a bright living room w/large bay window, formal dining room, spacious eat-in kitchen w/ center island, plenty of cabinet space, built-in appliances, Corian countertops & large pantry, updated half bath,& family room with skylight, gas fireplace (2020), & sliding glass doors leading to the backyard. Upstairs you'll find three generously sized bedrooms, the primary bedroom offers two closets, including a walk-in cedar closet. Freshly painted full bath w/tile surround. Full, dry basement w/glass block windows, laundry hookups, & two finished spaces providing the opportunity to install egress in order to make this a true 4-bedroom property. Outside is where this property really stands out w/a professionally installed DuraLife deck that overlooks the huge backyard & leads to a large concrete patio w/ firepit, perfect for entertaining or relaxing outdoors. An additional vinyl deck with locking gate surrounds the 27-foot above-ground pool, complete with a Hayward gas pool heater installed in 2023. Large shed for additional storage, extra-long & double-wide concrete driveway provides plenty of parking, attached 2.5-car garage w/ overhead storage & new garage doors (2023). Permanent APPECK exterior lighting adds year-round exterior lighting without the hassle of seasonal installation. Additional updates include electrical panel (2016), roof, gutters, soffits & vinyl siding (2021), HWT (2022)& boiler(2025). Square footage based on agent & seller measurements.
